notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves and/or Shamans.
description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Golgari Findbroker to your hand.
Cast Golgari Findbroker by paying {4}.
When Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Findbroker trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {5}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Elves and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite mana.
